mapper.select: SELECT * FROM capability_mutation_record WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND call_id = #{callId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO capability_mutation_record (run_id, call_id, capability, request_fingerprint, status, execution_token, lease_until, document_id, target_version_no, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{callId}, #{capability}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{status}, #{executionToken}, #{leaseUntil}, #{documentId}, #{targetVersionNo}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE capability_mutation_record SET status = 1, document_id = #{documentId}, previous_version_id = #{previousVersionId}, version_id = #{versionId}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND call_id = #{callId} AND request_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND execution_token = #{executionToken} AND status IN (0, 3)

UPDATE capability_mutation_record SET status = 3, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND call_id = #{callId} AND request_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND execution_token = #{executionToken} AND status = 0

UPDATE capability_mutation_record SET status = 2, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND call_id = #{callId} AND request_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND execution_token = #{executionToken} AND status = 0
